protocol.reference_selection: first annotated frame per category; remaining annotated frames are targets
protocol.query_contract: text verbatim; image masked crop with3px padding and gray127 outside; prompt one positive and one negative point with registered frozen geometry
protocol.image_conditioning_input: same authorized reference positive/negative pixels as prompt, in addition to reference image crop
protocol.ground_truth_domain: 2D category polygon unions; no 3D ground truth
protocol.instance_identity_assumption: same category across frames, union of category polygons; not independently verified physical instance tracks
